claims.citation: New York Herald, 18 August 1866, p. 3, col. 2
claims.verbatim:
Steamship Lafayette (Fr), Lemarie, Havre, Aug 2, via
Brest 4th, with mdse and 138 passengers, to George Mac-
kenzie. No date, lat 46 16, lon 41 40, saw bark Rome, of
Bath, from St John, NB, for Dublin; 20 miles S of Nan-
tucket, saw two screw steamers, bark rigged, steering E.

claims.citation: Hubbard & Winter, North Atlantic Mail Sailings 1840-75 (USPCS, 1988; rev. 2014), p. 278
